description: Native page-program codec slice: free-inverse shape/category/template page ordering, decoder-built page-shape memory, and a PAGE_SHAPE arithmetic event inside the receipt graph coder. Falls back to article_receipt_family_tree_v1 when complete archive selection rejects the page-program path.
codec: opcode receipt graph with native page-shape program events
notes: No serialized shape table or permutation table. The decoder rebuilds page shapes from decoded pages and restores source order by page id.
